sourceRecords.sourceTitle: Revolut Group Holdings Ltd Annual Report 2025
sourceRecords.shortExcerpt: The audited statements cover 2025 and report revenue, profit, total assets and customer liabilities.

observedFacts.statement: Revolut Group Holdings Ltd is the annual-report reporting entity and registered number 12743269 identifies the company.
BDO LLP audited the 2025 financial statements and gave a true-and-fair-view opinion for the Group and Parent Company.
Revenue for the year ended 2025-12-31 was GBP 4,515,770 thousand.
Profit before tax for the year ended 2025-12-31 was GBP 1,713,273 thousand.
Net profit for the year ended 2025-12-31 was GBP 1,304,628 thousand.
At 2025-12-31, the consolidated statement of financial position reported total assets of GBP 43,024,390 thousand.
At 2025-12-31, cash and cash equivalents were GBP 21,021,729 thousand and treasury investments were GBP 17,614,303 thousand.
value: cash and cash equivalents GBP 21,021,729 thousand

observedFacts.statement: At 2025-12-31, customer liabilities were GBP 36,880,199 thousand.
At 2025-12-31, loans and advances to customers were GBP 2,150,128 thousand.
Restricted cash and term deposits held in respect of customers include safeguarded funds related to regulated e-money and wealth services.
observedFacts.value: safeguarded funds for regulated e-money and wealth services

sourceRecords.sourceTitle: Revolut Completes Fundraising Process Establishing $75 Billion Valuation
sourceRecords.shortExcerpt: Revolut announced completion of a share sale, valuing the company at $75 billion.

observedFacts.statement: Revolut announced completion of the share sale on 2025-11-24.
The share sale established an implied headline valuation of USD 75 billion.
Current employees were given the opportunity to sell as part of the employee share sale.
The transaction was led by Coatue, Greenoaks, Dragoneer, and Fidelity Management & Research Company, with NVentures also participating.
Transaction terms, share rights, preferences, dilution, discounts, transaction volume, and cap-table data were not disclosed.
